caption: Each hop multiplies the copies by the fan-out of 3: 3, then 9, then 27. The hop limit stops the 27 peers holding the last round, so peers send 39 copies in all, and 40 copies exist once the originator's own copy is counted.

spec.title: Flooding with fan-out 3, TTL 3 hops
spec.aria: A chain of four steps: the originator sends 3 copies, those 3 send 9 more for a running total of 12, those 9 send 27 more for a running total of 39, and at TTL 0 the last 27 stop, leaving 40 copies counting the originator's own.
